label: Certiorari denied
caption: RITCHIE, BENJAMIN V. NEAL, WARDEN
text: The application for stay of execution of sentence of death presented to Justice Barrett and by her referred to the Court is denied. The petition for a writ of certiorari is denied. Justice Sotomayor and Justice Jackson would grant the application for a stay of execution of sentence of death and petition for a writ of certiorari.
